title: Cross-tissue transcriptomic module reproducibility analysis
description: Analysis code and supporting materials for evaluating reproducibility and interpretational limits of cross-tissue transcriptomic module projections. The release contains no redistributed raw GEO expression matrices or other third-party data.
notes: The public GitHub repository is available at https://github.com/shice951229-oss/cross-tissue-module-reproducibility. Release v1.0.0 archives validated commit 3eb6474. The version DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21762839 and the concept DOI for all versions is 10.5281/zenodo.21762838. Scientific results remain locked; raw_data_modified = FALSE; modules = 24; Tier A/B/C/D = 0/1/21/2.
